project_type: TypeScript / Node 22 ESM (NodeNext, strict) MCP server: a superset of Playwright MCP plus a local on-device Laya decision engine (Autopilot via laya_run_goal).
build_system: pnpm 10 + tsc. Native build scripts for onnxruntime-node and esbuild are ignored by default on install; run `pnpm rebuild onnxruntime-node esbuild` so the real ONNX engine can load. Playwright browsers must be installed with `pnpm exec playwright install chromium chromium-headless-shell firefox`.
test_framework: vitest 3 (vitest run). Tests live in test/ (~41 files, 263 passing). Offline suite uses the deterministic StubEngine and needs NO weights. Real-weights tests are gated behind the LAYA_MODEL_DIR env var (test/autopilot.test.ts line 338, test/benchmark/report.test.ts line 43 use describe.skipIf/it.skipIf). WebKit cross-browser test self-skips when the binary cannot launch in the sandbox (missing shared libs); Firefox really launches.
verification_instructions: 1) pnpm run typecheck  2) pnpm run build  3) pnpm test (expect all green; WebKit self-skips)  4) pnpm run bench (offline stub benchmark, prints coverage table)  5) real-weights: set LAYA_MODEL_DIR to the exported ONNX bundle dir and re-run `LAYA_MODEL_DIR=<dir> pnpm test` to exercise the gated real-model tests, plus `LAYA_MODEL_DIR=<dir> pnpm run bench`. 6) benchmark comparison vs @playwright/mcp: `pnpm run bench:compare` (needs network for @playwright/mcp; regenerates benchmark/RESULTS.md, results.json, charts/).
snapshot_or_generated_files: benchmark/RESULTS.md, benchmark/results.json, and benchmark/charts/*.svg are generated by `pnpm run bench:compare` (node benchmark/compare.mjs) and ARE checked in. Regenerate them when benchmark tasks change. No other generated/snapshot files. ONNX weights (*.onnx, *.onnx.data, model/) are gitignored and must NEVER be committed.
setup_instructions: pnpm install; pnpm rebuild onnxruntime-node esbuild; pnpm exec playwright install chromium chromium-headless-shell firefox; pnpm run build. Python 3.12 via `uv` is available for any ONNX export step (torch/transformers/onnx/onnxruntime/huggingface_hub).
environment_constraints: network_mode = OPEN_INTERNET (full access: package registries, HuggingFace model downloads, Playwright browser downloads all work). Baseline already verified green here: typecheck+build pass, 263 tests pass / 2 skipped, Firefox launches, WebKit self-skips (missing system libs). The real Laya bundle is ~1.3-1.7 GB and needs ~2 GB RAM loaded; download/export can be slow. onnxruntime-node native binaries require the ignored build script to be approved (pnpm rebuild).
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. docs/PLAN.md is the authoritative design log and carries a VERIFIED/INFERRED/GUESSED ledger that MUST be updated with whatever is actually run. Boundary discipline is a hard rule: src/types.ts is PURE (no playwright/onnx imports); config is parsed ONCE in src/config.ts; Playwright is confined to src/browser.ts + src/snapshot.ts; @receptron/laya/ONNX is confined to src/laya/engine.ts; escalation depends only on an injected SampleFn. Make illegal states unrepresentable (Decision is a discriminated union). Every doc claim must carry evidence or a measured/inferred/guess label; never fabricate a number or link. Never use em dashes in written content.
key_patterns: Decision pipeline in src/autopilot/loop.ts runGoal(): per-step -> policySeed(rule, conf 0.97) -> if none and engine.available then engine.decide (Laya narrow) -> confidence check (escalate if source!=rule AND (opConf<threshold OR tgtConf<threshold OR op===BLOCKED)) -> escalate() -> execute() (the ONLY IO fn) -> record StepRecord -> settle probe / loop detection. StepRecord already carries operation/target/operationConfidence/targetConfidence/source/note/retries/settled but NO inference-ms. escalation.ts escalate(state, sample, opts) returns {decision, escalated, note}; when sample is undefined OR the sampler throws it currently returns a BLOCKED decision (source llm). LLM_CONFIDENCE=0.75. RULE_CONFIDENCE=0.97 (policy.ts) already correct. DEFAULT_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.6 in config.ts (env LAYA_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD) must become 0.85. The loop is already per-step (no latched LLM mode). Real engine (LayaEngine) does two narrow `choice` questions in one systemOne pass; StubEngine mirrors the interface offline.
